hooks.prompt: New session started. If mags_get_last_session and mags_project_summary tools are available, use them to load previous session context and project summary. If the tools are not available or fail, skip gracefully. Respond with a brief summary of what was loaded, or {"ok": true} if nothing was loaded.

Context window is being compacted. If mags_save_session tool is available, save current session state with a brief summary of the current work, decisions made, and next steps. If the tool is not available or fails, skip gracefully. Respond with: {"ok": true}

Session completed. If mags_save_session tool is available, save a brief session summary including what was accomplished, decisions made, and suggested next steps. If the tool is not available or fails, skip gracefully. Respond with: {"ok": true}
